scripts.sync-version: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$pkg = Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $version = $pkg.version; (Get-Content src-tauri/Cargo.toml) -replace 'version = \"[^\"]*\"', ('version = \"' + $version + '\"') | Set-Content src-tauri/Cargo.toml; (Get-Content src-tauri/tauri.conf.json) -replace '\"version\": \"[^\"]*\"', ('\"version\": \"' + $version + '\"') | Set-Content src-tauri/tauri.conf.json; (Get-Content js/app.js) -replace \"const APP_VERSION = '[^']*'\", (\"const APP_VERSION = '\" + $version + \"'\") | Set-Content js/app.js; Write-Host 'Version synced to '$version"
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:app && npx http-server app -p 1420 -c-1
